extName.message: Redaxa – Redact PII & API Keys for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini

extDescription.message: Catch API keys, passwords and personal data before you send a prompt. Free checks run on your device.

welcomeTip.message: Pin Redaxa from the puzzle icon in the toolbar. Then use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity as usual: Redaxa checks your message when you send it.

intro.message: Catch API keys, passwords and personal details in a prompt, email or code before you share it.

textPlaceholder.message: Paste a prompt, email or code.

privacyLocal.message: Checked on this device. Your text is not sent anywhere.

privacyAccount.message: Checked by your Redaxa workspace. Text is not stored or sent to an AI provider.

accessFree.message: Free and unlimited. No account needed.

accessAccount.message: Includes your workspace's protected terms and team policies.

autoCheck.message: Check automatically before sending on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity

proTitle.message: Make it part of your workflow

proBody.message: Protected terms for your clients and projects, team policies that warn, redact or block, and deeper reviews of public GitHub repositories, including Git history, in the Windows app.

signInSummary.message: Already have an account? Sign in

planManage.message: Manage your plan in the workspace

lookForButton.message: Look for the Redaxa button on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity.

reviewAsk.message: Has Redaxa caught something for you? A short review helps other people find it.

credentialNote.message: The service is inferred from the format and context, not verified, and the key was not tested. If it is genuine, revoke or rotate it at the issuing service: deleting it from text or code does not revoke it.
